build_channel_directory: build the channel directory from session data and write it to a JSON cache file
load_directory: load the cached channel directory JSON and return platforms dictionary
resolve_channel_name: resolve a platform and channel name to its unique channel ID with case-insensitive and prefix matching
format_directory_for_display: format the channel directory into a human-readable string grouped by platform and guild
lookup_channel_type: look up the type of a channel by platform and channel ID
test_load_directory: test load_directory handles missing file, valid file, and corrupt JSON gracefully
test_resolve_channel_name: test resolve_channel_name with exact match, case-insensitive, guild-qualified, prefix match, and ambiguous resolution
test_build_from_sessions: test _build_from_sessions builds entries from sessions.json with deduplication and topic support
test_format_directory_for_display: test format_directory_for_display outputs grouped platform sections and channel labels
test_lookup_channel_type: test lookup_channel_type returns correct type for forum, regular, and unknown channels
